name: In-house retrieval eval — labeled query sets + provenance (the loop's quality yardstick)
annotator: agent (feat/1144-retrieval-eval implementation) + deterministic oracle generator for the synthetic core; LLM judges + owner adjudication for the authored set (status: pending — see judge protocol below)

oracle.excluded_reason: zero vocabulary overlap with the corpus token pool — no oracle target (empty relevant set); they remain #316 latency-mix probes
oracle.labeling: deterministic (no judges) — graded relevance derived from the latent-topic oracle (benchmarks/synthetic_corpus.py): grade 2 = target topic, grade 1 = NEAR (bridge-sharing) topics, grade 0 = rest; hidden topic not visible to retrieval

authored.source: real internal graph domain (anchor slice) — pricing/product, hybrid search engine, EP belief propagation, ops/runbooks, ontology/registry, benchmarks, memory, auth, strategy; authored from repository structure (docs/, product/, tortoise/), no query logs required
authored.labeling: subjective — two cross-vendor LLM judges (temp 0.0) over pooled top-50/strategy/query (deduped) + owner adjudication; kappa >= 0.60 via tools/kappa.py; adjudication acceptance >= 85% on the combined denominator, >= 10% sample

grades.2: relevant — the point directly answers the query or is centrally about its topic
grades.1: partially relevant — related background / adjacent context, mentions the topic or a directly connected concept
grades.0: non-relevant — unrelated; incidental token overlap is NOT relevance

metric_mapping.nDCG@10: headline; graded 3-level, log2 discount: DCG = sum (2^rel - 1)/log2(i+2); IDCG from the oracle's grade-2/grade-1 counts
metric_mapping.R@10: oracle denominator = grade-2 target set (ceiling 10/|target| ~ 12% at corpus 2000 / 24 topics)
metric_mapping.MRR: reciprocal rank of the first grade-2 doc

gate_semantics.loop: every retrieval optimization cycle ships iff speed improved (the #316 harness arm) AND quality did not regress
gate_semantics.ndcg: SHIP iff paired 90% CI on ΔnDCG@10 (points) does not exclude -2; WARN -2..-4; BLOCK < -4
gate_semantics.p5: BLOCK on a significant P@5 drop (paired 90% CI entirely below 0)
gate_semantics.bootstrap: 90% paired bootstrap CIs on per-query deltas (paired on identical query ids, resample query sets)

pooling.depth: top-50 per strategy per query (deduped across strategies)

environment.embedded: smoke only — FalkorDBLite has no FTS/HNSW: FTS degrades (parameter-bound queryNodes is unreliable on redislite), structural degrades to empty without a kind, vector runs brute-force; synthetic semantic query vectors stand in for the embedding model; numbers NOT prod-parity
environment.docker: authoritative — Docker FalkorDB >= 4.x with HNSW + FTS indexes (auto-created at boot) and the all-MiniLM embedding model; run on-demand per optimization cycle + monthly scheduled
